title: Complete Mobility Equipment Display
description: One complete static public-service mobility-equipment display scene, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. The whole original manual wheelchair occupies the left freestanding bay, the complete original four-wheel rollator occupies a separated middle bay, and one complete original open-cuff forearm crutch rests on a low right scene-only stand with a rear restraint appearance. A single continuous scene-only floor leaves a clear front visual circulation strip rather than an enclosing fixture wall or a service counter queue. Every original raw GLB buffer, local POSITION and NORMAL, material dictionary, per-face assignment and internal hierarchy is retained exactly; only declared whole-assembly translations at unit scale are added. New support geometry belongs only to this composition, not separately counted equipment. Static unoccupied exhibit only: no clinical treatment, patient guidance, medical suitability, device operation, load, balance, accessibility or circulation-code compliance, physical restraint performance, installation or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
